description: In-season retraining test (2026-11-21): B_width256 network trained on finalized histories, no reporting errors or trees, evaluated on finalized 2025-26 histories; (a) frozen: trained on 2022-23..2024-25 (us-flu-2025-26-finalized-coverage); (b) in-season: refit before each month of 2025-26 on every earlier week (us-flu-2025-26-inseason-finalized-coverage).
